spans.s:
पट् पटति split, burst, open (intr.). C. पाटयति cause
to split etc., break asunder, rend, tear, cut off, hurt, injure.
—अव C. split, tear asunder, open. उद् & समुद् C. the same + expel,
remove, dethrone. वि split, tear, rend, divide, root out, remove,
drive away.

पाट m. intersection;
 f. पाटा॑ N. of a cert. plant.
पटगत a. painted on cloth.
पटच्चर m. thief, robber.
पाटच्चर m. thief, robber.
1 पटर॑ m. or n. ray (of sunlight).
2 पट॑र m. E. of Varuna.
1 पटवास m. cloth, tent.
2 पटवास (& *˚क) m. perfumed powder.
पटवेश्मन् n. tent (house of cloth).
पटह m. (f. ई & n.) kettle-drum, abstr. ˚ता f.
पटहघोषक m. crier who beats a drum.
पटहघोषणा f. proclamation by sound of a drum.
पटाञ्चल m. the edge of a garment.
पटान्त m. the edge of a garment.
पटि f. a kind of woven cloth.
पटिका f. a kind of woven cloth.
पटिष्ठ (superl.) most clever with (—˚).
पटीक्षेप m. tossing up the curtain.

पटीयंस् (compar.) very clever in (—˚) or fit for (loc.
or —˚).
पटीर m. the sandal tree.
पाटीर m. the sandal-tree.
पटुता f. ˚त्व n. sharpness, cleverness.
पटुमति a. sagacious.
पटोत्तरीय n. upper garment (of cloth).
पटोल m. a kind of cucumber.
पटौर॑ m. a cert. member of the body.
पाटक m. who splits or tears asunder.
पट्टदोल n. or ˚ला f. a swing made of cloth.*
पट्टन n. town, city.
पाटन n. splitting, tearing asunder.
पट्टांशुक n. a kind of garment.*
पट्टिश m. a kind of spear, p. ˚शिन्.
पाटलावती f. N. of a river.
पाटलि f. N. of a tree.
पाटलिपुत्र n. N. of a city, pl. its inhabitants.
पाटव॑ n. sharpness, acuteness, dexterity.

पाटिन् a. splitting (—˚);
 m. a cert. fish.
पाटूर॑ m. the part near the ribs (of an animal).
